title: Solomon Q22 held-out compositional routing test
hypothesis: The inherited Solomon sparse integer class head passes all frozen overall, per-class, and cross-seed gates on surface-disjoint Q22 promotion templates with a common prefix and balanced wrong-operation distractors.
rationale: EXP-007 established that the class head could solve a prefix-separable routing surface. This successor removes that shortcut and tests whether the same model can use later operation evidence across held-out paraphrases without being captured by a balanced contradictory cue.

metrics.name: family_gate_ppm
metrics.description: One million only when every frozen overall, per-class, and agreement gate passes; otherwise zero

metrics.name: minimum_operation_exact_rate_ppm
metrics.description: Lowest exact operation-routing rate across the three frozen seeds

metrics.name: minimum_per_class_exact_rate_ppm
metrics.description: Lowest exact rate across every frozen seed and operation class

metrics.name: all_seed_agreement_rate_ppm
metrics.description: Promotion inputs receiving the same prediction from all three frozen seeds

outcomes.description: Every seed reaches 900000 overall ppm, every seed-class pair reaches 800000 ppm, and all-seed agreement reaches 950000 ppm.
